```{r}
# Clear the workspace and console.
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) 
cat("\f")

# Library packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(lsr)
```

```{r}
# read individual subject's csv file and compile
FilesList = list.files(pattern = "\\.csv$")
mergeddata <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:length(FilesList)) {
  fname=FilesList[i]
  subi <- read.csv(fname, fileEncoding="UTF-8-BOM")
  subi <- subset(subi, trials.thisN >= 0, select = c("distractorpresence", "triangleorient", "objectness", "distance", "search_resp.corr", "search_resp.rt", "participant"))
  mergeddata <- rbind(mergeddata, subi)
}
```

```{r}
# #-------------------------------------Data cleaning--------------------------------------------
# Data trimming for individual subject
searchalldata <- data.frame()

list <- unique(mergeddata$participant)
for (i in list) {

# Create dataframe for the ith subject
distractorpresencei <- mergeddata$distractorpresence[which(mergeddata$participant == i)]
objectnessi <- mergeddata$objectness[which(mergeddata$participant == i)]
distancei <- mergeddata$distance[which(mergeddata$participant == i)]
searchACCi <- mergeddata$search_resp.corr[which(mergeddata$participant == i)]
searchRTi <- mergeddata$search_resp.rt[which(mergeddata$participant == i)]

# Data trimming
# same object, near
# cell condition data
same_near_raw <- ifelse(distractorpresencei == 1 & objectnessi == "sameobject" & distancei == "near" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
same_near_mean <- mean(same_near_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
same_near_sd <- sd(same_near_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
same_near_trimmed <- ifelse(same_near_raw > same_near_mean - 2*same_near_sd & same_near_raw < same_near_mean + 2*same_near_sd, same_near_raw, NA)

# same object, far
# cell condition data
same_far_raw <- ifelse(distractorpresencei == 1 & objectnessi == "sameobject" & distancei == "far" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
same_far_mean <- mean(same_far_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
same_far_sd <- sd(same_far_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
same_far_trimmed <- ifelse(same_far_raw > same_far_mean - 2*same_far_sd & same_far_raw < same_far_mean + 2*same_far_sd, same_far_raw, NA)

# different object, near
# cell condition data
other_near_raw <- ifelse(distractorpresencei == 1 & objectnessi == "otherobject" & distancei == "near" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
other_near_mean <- mean(other_near_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
other_near_sd <- sd(other_near_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
other_near_trimmed <- ifelse(other_near_raw > other_near_mean - 2*other_near_sd & other_near_raw < other_near_mean + 2*other_near_sd, other_near_raw, NA)

# different object, far
# cell condition data
other_far_raw <- ifelse(distractorpresencei == 1 & objectnessi == "otherobject" & distancei == "far" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
other_far_mean <- mean(other_far_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
other_far_sd <- sd(other_far_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
other_far_trimmed <- ifelse(other_far_raw > other_far_mean - 2*other_far_sd & other_far_raw < other_far_mean + 2*other_far_sd, other_far_raw, NA)

# distractor absent
# cell condition data
absence_raw <- ifelse(distractorpresencei == 0 & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
absence_mean <- mean(absence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
absence_sd <- sd(absence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
absence_trimmed <- ifelse(absence_raw > absence_mean - 2*absence_sd & absence_raw < absence_mean + 2*absence_sd, absence_raw, NA)

# Trial Inclusion
trialinclude <- ifelse(same_near_trimmed | same_far_trimmed | other_near_trimmed | other_far_trimmed | absence_trimmed, 1, NA)
# total percentage of trimmed trials
proptrimmed_total <- 1 - sum(trialinclude, na.rm = T)/length(trialinclude)
# the subject's percentage of trials trimmed due to incorrect or absence of responses
proptrimmed_ACC <- 1 - mean(searchACCi)
# the subject's percentage of trials trimmed due to RT out of 2 SDs
proptrimmed_RT <- proptrimmed_total - proptrimmed_ACC

# Cell mean RT after trimming
same_near_rt <- mean(same_near_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
same_far_rt <- mean(same_far_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
other_near_rt <- mean(other_near_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
other_far_rt <- mean(other_far_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
absence_rt <- mean(absence_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
presence_rt <- mean(c(same_near_trimmed, same_far_trimmed, other_near_trimmed, other_far_trimmed), na.rm=TRUE)
# Cell mean accuracy
same_near_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 1 & objectnessi == "sameobject" & distancei == "near")])
same_far_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 1 & objectnessi == "sameobject" & distancei == "far")])
other_near_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 1 & objectnessi == "otherobject" & distancei == "near")])
other_far_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 1 & objectnessi == "otherobject" & distancei == "far")])
absence_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 0)])
presence_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 1)])

# subjects who showed suppression
suppressionindex <- ifelse(presence_rt < absence_rt, 1, 0)

subID <- i
objectness <- c('sameobject', 'sameobject', 'differentobject', 'differentobject', 'disabsent', 'dispresent')
distance <- c('near', 'far', 'near', 'far', 'NA', 'NA')
RT <- c(same_near_rt, same_far_rt, other_near_rt, other_far_rt, absence_rt, presence_rt)
ACC <- c(same_near_acc, same_far_acc, other_near_acc, other_far_acc, absence_acc, presence_acc)
objectcombined <- c('sameobject', 'differentobject', NA, NA, NA, NA)
objectRT <- c(mean(c(same_near_rt, same_far_rt)), mean(other_near_rt, other_far_rt), NA, NA, NA, NA)
objectACC <- c(mean(c(same_near_acc, same_far_acc)), mean(other_near_acc, other_far_acc), NA, NA, NA, NA)
distancecombined <- c('near', 'far', NA, NA, NA, NA)
distanceRT <- c(mean(c(same_near_rt, other_near_rt)), mean(same_far_rt, other_far_rt), NA, NA, NA, NA)
distanceACC <- c(mean(c(same_near_acc, other_near_acc)), mean(same_far_acc, other_far_acc), NA, NA, NA, NA)
subimean <- data.frame(subID, objectness, distance, RT, ACC, objectcombined, objectRT, objectACC, distancecombined, distanceRT, distanceACC, proptrimmed_RT, proptrimmed_ACC,suppressionindex)
# testing whether the subject meets an overall accuracy of 80% or greater to be included in analyses
subimean$subinclude <- ifelse(mean(searchACCi) > 0.8, 1, 0)

#Add the ith subject's data to a combined dataframe
searchalldata <- rbind(searchalldata, subimean)

}

# remove subjects who didn't meet criteria
include <- searchalldata$subID[which(searchalldata$subinclude == 1)]
# create a new data frame with subjects who failed to meet the accuracy criterion removed
searchcleandata <- searchalldata[which(searchalldata$subID %in% include),]

# overall search accuracy
mean(searchalldata$ACC)
# proportion trial abandoned
# by RT criteria
mean(searchcleandata$proptrimmed_RT)
# by ACC == 0
mean(searchcleandata$proptrimmed_ACC)

# recode for graphing
searchcleandata$RT <- searchcleandata$RT*1000
searchcleandata$ACC <- searchcleandata$ACC*100

# view summary table
searchcleandata %>% group_by(objectness, distance) %>% summarise(meanrt = mean(RT), meanacc = mean(ACC))
```

```{r}
# #-------------------------------------Figures-------------------------------------------            
# RT plot
ggplot(data=searchcleandata, aes(x=factor(objectness, order = T, levels = c('disabsent','dispresent','sameobject','differentobject')), y=RT, fill=distance))+
      stat_summary(fun.y="mean", geom="bar", position=position_dodge(), width = 0.5)+
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(550,650,20))) +
      coord_cartesian( ylim = c(550,650)) +
      ylab("Reation Time (ms)")+ 
      xlab("Target-distractor location")+ 
      ggtitle("Reaction time as a function of the relative location of target to distractor") + 
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 15)) + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15)) +
    #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_rt-se_rt, ymax=mean_rt+se_rt), width=.1, position=position_dodge(.9))+
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))

# accuracy plot
ggplot(data=searchcleandata, aes(x=factor(objectness, order = T, levels = c('disabsent','dispresent','sameobject','differentobject')), y=ACC, fill=distance))+
      stat_summary(fun.y="mean", geom="bar", position=position_dodge(), width = 0.5)+
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(seq(90,100, 2))) +
      coord_cartesian( ylim = c(90,100)) +
      ylab("Accuracy (%)")+ 
      xlab("Target-distractor location")+ 
      ggtitle("Accuracy as a function of the relative location of target to distractor")+
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 15)) + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15)) +
    #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_acc-se_acc, ymax=mean_acc+se_acc), width=.1, position=position_dodge(.9))+ 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------- Statistical Analysis ----------------------------------
# ******************RT**************************
# --------examining the suppression effect--------------------
# t-test in RT comparing distractor present and absent
t_distractorpresence_RT <- t.test(searchcleandata$RT[which(searchcleandata$objectness == "dispresent" | searchcleandata$objectness == "disabsent")] ~ searchcleandata$objectness[which(searchcleandata$objectness == "dispresent" | searchcleandata$objectness == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 
t_distractorpresence_RT
cohensD(subset(searchcleandata,searchcleandata$objectness == "dispresent" | searchcleandata$objectness == "disabsent")$RT ~ 
         subset(searchcleandata,searchcleandata$objectness == "dispresent" | searchcleandata$objectness == "disabsent")$objectness, method = "paired")

# --------ANOVA between distance and objectness--------------------
RT.aov <- anova_test(
  data = searchcleandata[searchcleandata$objectness != "dispresent" & searchcleandata$objectness != "disabsent",], dv = RT, wid = subID,
  within = c(objectness, distance), effect.size = "pes"
  )
get_anova_table(RT.aov)

# ******************Accuracy**************************
# --------examining the suppression effect--------------------
# t-test in ACC comparing distractor present and absent
t_distractorpresence_ACC <- t.test(searchcleandata$ACC[which(searchcleandata$objectness == "dispresent" | searchcleandata$objectness == "disabsent")] ~ searchcleandata$objectness[which(searchcleandata$objectness == "dispresent" | searchcleandata$objectness == "disabsent")], paired = TRUE) 
t_distractorpresence_ACC
cohensD(subset(searchcleandata,searchcleandata$objectness == "dispresent" | searchcleandata$objectness == "disabsent")$ACC ~ 
         subset(searchcleandata,searchcleandata$objectness == "dispresent" | searchcleandata$objectness == "disabsent")$objectness, method = "paired")

# --------ANOVA between distance and objectness--------------------
ACC.aov <- anova_test(
  data = searchcleandata[searchcleandata$objectness != "dispresent" & searchcleandata$objectness != "disabsent",], dv = ACC, wid = subID,
  within = c(objectness, distance), effect.size = "pes"
  )
get_anova_table(ACC.aov)
```
